book_title: Finding the Venom To End: Protecting My Family Prevails
author: Daisy O. Harrison
book_description: This final book of the trilogy, Love & Venom follows the adult brothers, Enzo and Father Andrew and their roles in the greatest period of Renaissance Italy in the 14th century. Share their success with Lorenzo de Medici and his manipulation, threats or bribery in government and business. Commiserate with them in their struggles to survive after Florence exiled all Medici and allies immediately after the death of Lorenzo. How did the brothers manipulate the end of the "vanity bonfires of art and secular books" by theocratic ruler Dominican Friar Savonarola? What event allowed the return of the Medici family to Florence? Discover how Pope Alexander VI, Emperor Charles V, and the Medici brothers ended the republic and made Italy a monarchy. Of course, the first royal Duke of Florence was a Medici married to Bella, a daughter of Enzo.Behind the public conflicts, assassinations and mysterious deaths was Sophia. The matriarch who was the kindest person in the Medici household and a motherly patron to all the artists supported by her brother-in-law Lorenzo. She had a special fondest for Michelangelo, who spent over three years in the Medici household.She protected her family at all costs. Was she involved in several mysterious deaths related to the many sinister plans, manipulations and intermarriages toward the ultimate aim of maintaining power by the Medici family?Show more
